tuning.title: Tuning report
tuning.window.suggested: Suggested test windows (loop in manual, output moved)
tuning.window.none: No test window found: the loop was never in manual with output moves. The whole record is used; the result may be unreliable.
tuning.fit.good: The model fits the data well (R² {r2}).
tuning.fit.fair: The model fits moderately (R² {r2}); treat the settings with care.
tuning.fit.poor: The model fits poorly (R² {r2}); do not rely on these settings.
tuning.warning.closed_loop_data: The window contains closed-loop (auto) data, so the model can be biased. Prefer a step test with the loop in manual.
tuning.blocked.stiction: Retuning is blocked: stiction suspected. Repair the valve first.
tuning.blocked.model_failed: No model could be identified on this window. Choose another window.
tuning.blocked.poor_fit: The model fits this window poorly, so the settings are withheld. Choose a window with a clearer step.

tuning.readOnly: Nothing is written to the plant.
benefit.title: Benefit report
benefit.disclaimer: This number is an estimate. It shows what lower variability could be worth if the freed room can really be used; that needs a trial.
benefit.limit.default: No limit given: placeholder {value} {unit}. Enter the real limit.
benefit.value: Value of one unit for one hour
benefit.reduction: Variability cut (share of the standard deviation removed)
benefit.reduction.measured: Cut measured from the retune: standard deviation {before} -> {after}, {percent} % removed. The slider is not used.
benefit.stdBefore: Standard deviation before a retune (PV units)
benefit.stdAfter: Standard deviation after a retune (PV units)
benefit.gap: Gap between the mean and the limit now
benefit.note.beyond_limit: The mean is already beyond the limit.
benefit.note.near_limit: The limit is already violated or nearly so at the current variability.
benefit.note.no_value: No value per unit given, so no money is shown.
benefit.chart: PV distribution now and after the variability cut (sketch with normal curves)

loops.sharedPeriod: Cycling at the same period as: {loops}
loops.notAssessedBody: These checks need data about the loop that is not configured: {missing}. Until then "No problems found" only covers the checks that could run.
knowledge.title: Loop data
knowledge.intro: The analysis needs a few facts about this loop. Without them it skips the checks that depend on them. The values are saved in the project file (project.json) of this dataset on this computer; nothing is sent to the plant.
knowledge.delayHelp: Time between a change of the controller output and the first visible reaction of the measurement. Unlocks: Harris index.
knowledge.ultimateHelp: Period of the loop's natural oscillation when it is pushed to the edge of stability. Needed together with the amplitude limit.
knowledge.amplitudeHelp: Largest oscillation of the measurement you accept in normal operation. Unlocks: oscillation amplitude check.
knowledge.error: Could not use the loop data: {reason}
knowledge.rangeOutMissing: The output tag has no engineering range, so saturation and valve numbers cannot be assessed. Set the range on the output tag.
knowledge.rangePvMissing: The measurement tag has no engineering range; the amplitude limit must then be entered by hand.
tuning.current.title: Compare with the current settings
tuning.current.intro: Enter the settings the controller uses now to see how far the proposal is from them. They stay in this browser only.
tuning.current.close: The current settings are within 10 % of this proposal.
tuning.current.differs: The current settings differ from this proposal by more than 10 %. Change one setting at a time and watch the loop.
